name: Rettou Idenshi ni Yogosareru
original_name: 劣等遺伝子に汚される
source:
A Day in the Life of an Unusual Student

Tomona Kurokami was spending her school days with a cold heart.
One day, her body encounters many inferior genes.
How will her cool and dignified character change or even come to an end? ……

What fate awaits her after she continues to satisfy her decadent desires? ……​
